note: The upper city on its shelf just east of the falls, directly overlooking its Slums. Name and population are placeholders

args.name: Slaver Upper Camp
args.note:
[placeholder] Name from the regional overview, not approved.

Upper city of Act I's medium city: nobles and wealthier civilians, walled, with a citadel. It sits on a bench cut into the escarpment directly above its Slums, and draws its water from the falls stream upstream of them.

Population: placeholder; about 15,000 across the city with the Slums.

note: The Slums: the poor lower quarter of the same city, at the foot of the falls below the upper city. Act I's quest hub

args.name: Slums
args.note:
[placeholder] Name from the regional overview, not approved.

The poor slums of the slaver city, at the foot of the escarpment directly below the upper city, and Act I's quest hub. Their people are free citizens: slavers do not take people from the city, only escaped slaves, the wanted and fugitives. The falls above are their water source, with wells and cisterns as backup.

Population: placeholder share of the city's 15,000.

note: Ruined Outpost between the Slums and the washes
